references.text: Herod sends the wise men to Bethlehem to find Jesus, with the hidden goal of killing him, which mirrors Herod's order to the wise men to report back to him.
Moses sends spies into Canaan to explore the land, paralleling Herod sending the wise men to find Jesus.
Herod's anger and the killing of the children in Bethlehem after the wise men did not return to him, following directly from his instructions to the wise men.
